name: 金庸群侠传（2008 加强版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Enhanced Edition)
english_description: Self-titled "Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes," this archive corresponds to the "2008 Enhanced" content release. It's an independent branch of the "ES II" engine family (tracing to author Phoebus.suny's 1998 ES2 "Heavenly Court, Earthly Realm" release); this project also holds other content releases built on the same engine core (Standard, Deluxe, and 2015 editions) — essentially the same server program with different content configurations.
